proof_scope: Live existing pitchdeck source tab and its one user-requested companion. Set PITCHDECK_SOURCE_TAB to the existing source tab. No source/test window is created; the named companion is reused and retained for the user.

claims.proves: Separate page/window, exact current-slide notes, oversized adjustable text, slide navigation sync, companion reload reconnection, and named-window reuse. Malformed and cross-source messages are refused; an unbound connection does not display stale notes.
claims.does_not_prove: Cross-origin or cross-browser sync, private-data access control against same-origin scripts, speech quality, automatic monitor selection, or unrelated motion/export behavior.
